summary: No comma operator to run several expressions in one statement, parentheses or not.
why: The comma operator hides a second statement inside one line and is easy to mistake for an argument list.
note: oxfmt wraps every sequence in parentheses, so parentheses are not allowed as a way out. The setup and update parts of a `for` loop, such as `for (let i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i += 1)`, are still allowed.
